caption: An 80-man infantry block on 12 files is dragged into a 9-file line just ahead of it, and re-forms in place before it marches off. Its men walk across the files to their places in the narrower, deeper block. The closest two now stay 6.2 wu apart as they cross: still nearer than the 9 wu two bodies take up, but above the 2.25 wu overlap floor. Before this fix the men stopped keeping apart for the whole of a reform hold, and walked through one another: two of them came within 0.49 wu. The same thing let a block scrambled by a fight walk its men through each other as it re-formed on its next order (the showcase clip's archers).
